title: Amazingly Crispy Mexican Baby Aubergine Quesadilla
description: A rich and crispy weeknight Mexican dish featuring baby aubergine, this quesadilla is perfect for a flavorful dinner. It is made using a mortar and pestle to pound the ingredients and is FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Preheat a large cazuela over medium heat.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the sliced red onion, chopped cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper until well combined.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced baby aubergine with the pounded onion mixture until the aubergine is evenly coated.
In the preheated cazuela, add the olive oil and cook the coated aubergine slices for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked aubergine slices and shredded monterey jack cheese.
Place a large corn tortilla in the cazuela and sprinkle a quarter of the aubergine and cheese mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook the quesadilla for 2-3 minutes on each side, until it is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients to make three more quesadillas.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
